entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Paul Joseph Bradley is an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as bishop of the Diocese of Kalamazoo in Michigan from 2009 to 2023. He was an auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Pittsburgh in Pennsylvania from 2004 to 2009.
